transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... well, mostly I'm just here because of my sleep. It's been... broken, I guess, for a long time now. I fall into bed completely exhausted, but then I wake up to every little sound in the house. And... I'm always up before my alarm even goes off. I just never really feel rested.
Do you often find yourself worrying about things?
I don't know. I mean... I guess I worry about normal things. Nothing specific, really. Just the usual stuff.
Do you find that you worry more than other people?
I... I don't really know how much other people worry. I just... I think I'm about average. I don't really talk to people about that kind of thing.
Do you often find yourself worrying about things even when everything is going well?
Um... no, not really. If things are actually fine, I just... I don't go looking for things to stress over. I don't think I do that, anyway.
Do you feel anxious most of the time?
Not really. I mean... no. I wouldn't say I feel anxious. I just... I don't think I feel like that most of the time.
Do you often feel tired or low in energy?

Yeah... I guess so. By the time I finish seeing my home-health clients and get back to help around the house, I just... my body feels heavy. Sometimes just finishing my charting notes or... folding laundry... it just feels like too much to push through.
Do you often feel like you could fall asleep during the day?
No... not really. I mean, I'm tired, but... I don't usually feel like I'm just going to fall asleep in the middle of the day. I just keep going.
Do you ever feel like you're sleeping too much?

No... not too much. It's more that... my sleep is just broken. I fall into bed exhausted, but I wake up to every little sound in the house. And then I'm usually up before my alarm anyway... just never really feeling rested.
Do you often find yourself worrying about things that are not currently problems?
No, not really. I mean... I worry about the normal things, I guess. Bills, my kids... but not things that aren't actually happening.
Do you often need to take naps during the day to feel rested?
No... I don't really take naps. I just... push through it, usually.
Do you often find yourself worrying about things that might happen in the future?
No... I don't think so. Like I said before, it's really just the normal stuff. I mostly just try to get through the day.
Do you often find yourself worrying about things even when there's no obvious reason to worry?
No, not really. I don't... I don't just sit around worrying for no reason. It's just the normal things I mentioned.
Do you often find yourself preoccupied with worry?
No... I mean, I think I just answered that. I'm not really preoccupied with it. It's just the usual things.
Do you find that you have a regular sleep schedule?

No, not really... I mean, that's actually kind of why I'm here. My sleep has been broken for a long time. I just... I fall into bed exhausted, but then I wake up to every little sound. And then I'm always up before my alarm goes off, just... feeling like I didn't rest at all. So, no, it's not regular.
Do you have difficulty falling asleep at the beginning of the night?
No. I usually go to sleep fine. Like I said, I'm just so tired by then, I drop right off.
Do you often feel drowsy or sleepy during the day?
No, not really. I just... I keep moving during the day, so I don't really notice it. I just go to work and do what I need to do.
Do you have trouble staying asleep once you've fallen asleep?
Yeah, I... I think I mentioned that earlier. I wake up to every little noise. So, yes, staying asleep is hard.
Do you find that your sleep patterns are tied to a regular day-night cycle?
I'm not really sure what you mean. I just... I go to bed at night. I haven't really paid attention to cycles or anything like that.
Have you ever been diagnosed with or experienced symptoms of depression?

I haven't been diagnosed with anything. I just... I guess most days it feels like the color has gone out of things. Even when I'm sitting at Sunday dinner with my family, or... looking at art I used to enjoy. I just... I have to work really hard not to tear up. For no clear reason. So... I don't know. Maybe.
Do you find pleasure in activities you used to enjoy?
I don't really know. I guess not. Like I said, things just feel... dull. I don't really do much besides work anyway, so... I haven't really thought about it.
